name: honest-arcade
description: Ad-free games built with three.js and plain web tech: puzzles, a brick breaker, a coin pusher and slot machines with play money. Playable in the browser, packaged for Android (and later iOS) with Capacitor.

scripts.test: node tests/puzzles.mjs && node tests/economy.mjs && node tests/unscrew.mjs && npm run test:slots && npm run test:wallbreaker && npm run test:coin-dozer && npm run build -- --experimental && node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/slots/e2e.mjs && node tests/wallbreaker/e2e.mjs && node tests/coin-dozer/e2e.mjs
scripts.test:slots: node scripts/slots-validate.mjs && node --test tests/slots/*.test.mjs && node scripts/slots-sim.mjs --check
